name: self_camera_take_photo
description: Take a photo using the device's camera. This tool captures the current camera frame and returns the image data. You MUST call this tool when user asks to 'take a photo', 'what do you see', 'describe what you see', or similar requests. After getting the photo data, describe what you see in the image. Parameter 'question' is optional, defaults to 'describe objects seen'.

question.description: Question to guide the photo analysis, e.g., 'describe the objects seen'. Can be empty.

mockResponse.response: Please describe what you see based on the returned photo_data

name: self.get_device_status
description:
查询设备的实时状态信息，包括扬声器音量、屏幕亮度、电池电量、网络连接等。
仅在用户明确询问设备状态时调用（如：当前音量多少、电量还有多少、屏幕亮度是多少、网络状态怎么样），不要作为设备控制的前置步骤。

name: self.audio_speaker.set_volume
description: 设置扬声器音量（0-100）。用户说「音量调到X」「声音大一点」「声音小一点」「静音」时直接调用此工具。

name: self.screen.set_brightness
description: 设置屏幕亮度（0-100）。用户说「屏幕亮度调到X」「亮度高一点」「亮度低一点」时直接调用此工具。
